notes: 'Who is' is one added unit headed on is: the Hebrew sets יְשׁוּעֹת פָּנַי in bare apposition to him with no relative and no verbless clause, so no morpheme licenses either word and the contiguous pair does one office (rules 2, 55). The competing reading, giving is to יְשׁוּעֹת under rule 20 with Who alone added, is named in the unit note.
Second מַה is written here and takes its own why; Hope thou keeps the pronoun with the imperative (rule 17).
